description: Land Acquisition - Ihala Karagahamuna D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. It provides detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
